about.heading: About
paragraphs: I build machine learning systems end to end: clean the data, train the model, measure it honestly, then ship it as an API or a small web demo. Most of my work sits in computer vision and language models.

I graduated in Information Technology from UIN Ar-Raniry Banda Aceh with a 3.77/4.00 GPA. For my thesis I fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL with QLoRA to read printed Jawi script and transliterate it into Rumi, then published the adapter on Hugging Face.

Before that I built the tourism recommender NusantaraGo-ML, took Best Capstone Project at Asah led by Dicoding with Pacu Pintar, and worked as a lab assistant for a semester teaching computer vision and Java fundamentals.

work.heading: Selected work
work.intro: Six projects across research, ML APIs, and data tooling. Each one started with a problem worth solving.

items.title: Jawi OCR and Transliteration
items.description: Jawi texts use an Arabic-Malay script that most readers today cannot parse. The model targets printed Jawi (cetak): I fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL-3B with QLoRA on synthetic and scanned page images, then ran a three-way data ablation. The final adapter cut character error rate from 82.5% to 17.4% on Jawi extraction and from 90.6% to 16.5% on Rumi transliteration.

items.title: Pacu Pintar
items.description: Students stall when course material outruns their learning pace. With one teammate I built the ML side of Pacu Pintar: a Random Forest that sorts learners into consistent, fast, or reflective pace at about 90% accuracy, plus a FastAPI service that returns LLM-written study suggestions.

items.title: NusantaraGo-ML
items.description: Travelers get generic destination lists that ignore what they actually like. I built a hybrid recommender, content-based scoring plus user-based collaborative filtering, and served it through Flask so a short preference form returns ranked Indonesian destinations.

items.title: Climate Impact on Agriculture
items.description: Agricultural planners lack a clear read on how climate shifts hit crop yields. I clustered a Kaggle agriculture-climate dataset to surface regional patterns, then trained classifiers to predict specific harvest yields from climate variables, and wrote both notebooks so the analysis could be rerun.

items.title: Bike-Sharing Demand Dashboard
items.description: Bike-sharing operators need to know which conditions drive rentals. I compared seasonal, weather, and hourly patterns in the UCI rental dataset, ran clustering to separate usage groups, and shipped a Streamlit dashboard with date, season, and weather filters.

items.title: Memory Vault AI
items.description: Assistants forget everything the moment a session ends. I built Memory Vault AI, a Python layer between an app and any LLM: it captures turns, extracts facts, compresses old context, then injects relevant memories into each new prompt. Published on PyPI as memory-vault.
